title: goniophlebium pseudoconnatum
intro: Goniophlebium pseudoconnatum, commonly known as the Himalayan maidenhair fern, is a type of epiphytic fern native to the Himalayan and subtropical regions of Asia. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Goniophlebium pseudoconnatum include its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit microbial growth, and scavenge free radicals. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
